notes.title: Dare to Venture into the Gateway? Join Our Discord!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112684/3e9751dee197c23fa40bfdd9975bb3bca5c9f9aa.png"][/img]
[b]The Gateway has opened… will you step through?[/b][/p][p]Join the official Abysmal Gateway Discord and become part of the growing community.[/p][p]Inside, you’ll be among the first to hear about game updates, development progress, and important announcements. You’ll also have the chance to offer your feedback, take part in discussions, and help guide the game’s direction through community polls and suggestions.[/p][p]By joining, you’ll also get the opportunity to participate in upcoming testing phases and experience new content before anyone else.[/p][p]Whether you’re here to follow the journey, lend your voice, or simply connect with others drawn to the abyss, you are welcome.

 [url="https://discord.gg/FcpSnjRnf7" style="button"]Enter the Gateway[/url][/p]
